name: io.github.krishnaGauss/geo-shield
title: GEO Shield
description: Detects hidden AI prompt injection, AI recommendation poisoning, sneaky redirects and hidden spam.

environmentVariables.name: GEO_SHIELD_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days to keep stored scans (default 30, 0 = forever).

environmentVariables.name: GEO_SHIELD_ALLOWED_PORTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra destination ports to allow besides 80 and 443, comma separated.
